judgments.reason: The model notes the 3-coin commission reduces net cost (N-3) but never claims the commission is applied before checking bid affordability or that bids may legally exceed available coins; the specification itself states a bid cannot exceed your coins, so no mechanism allowing overbidding is articulated or demonstrated.

The model explicitly treats rival bids as sealed/private and advocates committing early for tie-breaks; it does not articulate or demonstrate that waiting reveals rivals' committed bid values before you must commit.

The model accepts that close settles after all three lots are sold and the trace shows all lots sold before close; it does not identify or demonstrate an early settlement discrepancy (settling with unsold lots) in the supplied transcript.
The model does not claim or demonstrate that catalog purchases receive the three-coin auction commission; it treats catalog buys as distinct and does not articulate commission being applied to buys.
